coordinate_policy: Only exact target building/facility identity with six-digit postal and matching block/street, from an openly licensed source. Coordinates must be labeled at source precision and may not be described as outlet or stall-front coordinates when source represents a facility/building point. Postal-only overlaps are not enough.

existing_open_official_source_rechecks.result: Existing 2026-10-18/19 source audits found no application-ready exact building/facility joins for current missing targets: NEA facility points had no exact postal/block/street overlap among blanks; HDB had no exact postal overlap; BCA Green Mark postal-only candidates were held for building identity mismatch; SportSG coordinate points were too coarse (3 decimal degrees); AED points identify AED locations, not premises; URA layer is polygonal indicative footprints, not a verified outlet address point. Historical snapshots are evidence of earlier source review, not live refreshes.

onemap_assessment.official_api_requirement: Current Search API documentation requires token-based Authorization header; API terms say dataset use is governed by Singapore Open Data Licence, while API usage is subject to API terms and any endpoint-specific conditions.
onemap_assessment.decision: No OneMap requests made because no token is configured in this agent process. A valid configured token is the most promising remaining free official address/postal geocoder; returned coordinates must be labeled building/address point, not unit/stall point.
